name: craft-shop
description: A Craft Shop pane for Claude Code: a worktree with a read-only head start, crew dials, a context library and an API workbench.

autoWorktree.title: Auto worktree
autoWorktree.description: Move each session started in a main checkout into a worktree of its own, read-only until it is ready.

setupCommand.title: Setup command
setupCommand.description: A shell command run in a new slot before the session moves in (say `pnpm install`). Empty runs nothing.

apiBase.title: API base URL
apiBase.description: The local server the API tab and the api_send tool talk to.

openapiPath.title: OpenAPI file
openapiPath.description: The OpenAPI JSON file the API tab reads. Empty looks for openapi.json in the project.
